title: CausalT5K: Diagnosing and Informing Refusal for Trustworthy Causal Reasoning of Skepticism, Sycophancy, Detection-Correction, and Rung Collapse
reasoning: The paper uses 'Law & Ethics' as one of its ten thematic domains for testing causal reasoning; however, the benchmark focuses on evaluating causal logic traps (such as survivorship bias or confounding) rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, spiritual, or moral/ethical values and belief systems.
